title: recurring-events.html
content: Change to the Recurring Events Logic The Recurring Events logic now uses the Event {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} instead of the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} to determine if an Event is active.  {{snippet.TotalCapacitySetting}} Introduction {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} s allow you to create a series of forward-looking, scheduled {{variable.Object_Event}} s based on criteria you define through our easy preset or advanced fields. You can: Create {{variable.Object_Event}} s for different dates automatically. If you have consistent dates and times, you can create multiple {{variable.Object_Event}} s within minutes instead of creating each one manually. Clone Smart Scheduler scheduled emails (Schedule and Schedule Action records) created from the master template. Have a complex recurring schedule? Use our advanced scheduling feature to get close to your unique recurring dates and times. For example, you can schedule a campus tour for the first Wednesday of every month. Continue reading to learn more! Before you Create Recurring Events Complete the following tasks before you create your first {{variable.Object_Event}} . Add Fields to the Event Object The first step is to add any fields that need to be cloned to the {{variable.Object_Event}} object. Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} . Click {{variable.Button_Setup}} . Click the Object Manager tab. In the Quick Find box, enter and click “Event” (conference360__Event__c). Click Field Sets. Click Deep Clone Layout. Drag and drop the fields in the “In the Field Set” box. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Update the Event Settings Record The second step is to update the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record that will be related to the first {{variable.Object_Event}} . This will allow you to create {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} s, but they won’t be published automatically. Go to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Confirm that the {{variable.Field_ETSetting_Req1TicketPubl}} field is on the page layout. If it is, go to the next step. If it isn’t, go to the steps below. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set to {{variable.Field_ETSetting_Req1TicketPubl}} to “No”. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . If the {{variable.Field_ETSetting_Req1TicketPubl}} field isn’t on the page layout, complete the steps below. Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} . Click {{variable.Button_Setup}} . Click the Object Manager tab. In the Quick Find box, enter and click “Event Settings”. Click Page Layouts. Click Event Settings Layout. Drag and drop the {{variable.Field_ETSetting_Req1TicketPubl}} field on to the page layout. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Go back to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record and refresh the page. Find the {{variable.Field_ETSetting_Req1TicketPubl}} field and click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon. Set to {{variable.Field_ETSetting_Req1TicketPubl}} to “No”. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Create a Recurring Event Create an {{variable.Object_Event}} that will be referenced when creating {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} s. The {{variable.Object_Event}} will be cloned, and the dates will be updated based on the schedule defined. An open-ended {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} is an {{variable.Object_Event}} that is created repeatedly, with no end date defined. The {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} will continue to be created until you close it.   Click {{variable.Button_Event_CreateRecurrEvent}} . Complete the fields in the sections below. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .   Don’t Forget to Schedule the Batch Job Please make sure to schedule the following batch job by clicking the {{variable.Button_ET_ScheduleRecEventJobs}} button on the Blackthorn | Events Admin tab. The Blackthorn | Events Recurring Event Generate scheduled job runs nightly at 3:00 AM and updates and creates Recurring Events set to “Keep One Open” or “Auto Renew.” Information What is the difference between Frequency and Count? The Frequency field represents the interval between the repeating values. For example, a Monthly setting with a Frequency of "2" means every two months, while a Daily setting with a Frequency of "45" means every 45 days. The Count is the number of times this Event will generate. For example, if the Count = "6", this Event will generate six Recurring Events. {{variable.Field_RecEvent_ScheduleStatus}} (required) To generate the {{variable.Object_Event}} s for your {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} , set {{variable.Field_RecEvent_ScheduleStatus}} to "Generate". This triggers the system to create all {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} s based on your {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} 's {{variable.Field_RecEvent_EZPreset}} . If you set {{variable.Field_RecEvent_ScheduleStatus}} to anything other than "Draft" or "Generate" nothing will happen. Those settings are meant to be automatically updated. {{variable.Field_RecEvent_EventTemplateMa}} (required) {{variable.Field_RecEvents_RecurrenceMeth}} :   If the Blackthorn | Events Settings custom setting {{variable.CS_RecurriEVActiveEVValidation}} = “False” (unchecked), the {{variable.Field_RecEvents_RecurrenceMeth}} options work as follows. {{variable.Picklist_RecET_RecMeth_None}} : The {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} is not open-ended and will end after the number of completed {{variable.Object_Event}} s matches the amount in the {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} field. {{variable.Picklist_RecET_RecMeth_Keep1Op}} : After one {{variable.Object_Event}} is completed, one or more {{variable.Object_Event}} s are generated according to the {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} field. To ensure that a new/active {{variable.Object_Event}} will be added, set {{variable.Field_RecEvents_RecurrenceMeth}} = {{variable.Picklist_RecET_RecMeth_Keep1Op}} and the {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} to "1" or more. {{variable.Picklist_RecET_RecMeth_AutoRen}} : After all initial {{variable.Object_Event}} s are completed, the {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} will generate the full {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} again. For example, 3 original {{variable.Object_Event}} s, now 3 new future {{variable.Object_Event}} s. If the Blackthorn | Events Settings custom setting {{variable.CS_RecurriEVActiveEVValidation}} = "True" (checked), the {{variable.Field_RecEvents_RecurrenceMeth}} options work as follows. {{variable.Picklist_RecET_RecMeth_None}} : The {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} is not open-ended and will end after the number of completed {{variable.Object_Event}} s matches the amount in the {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} field. {{variable.Picklist_RecET_RecMeth_Keep1Op}} : After one Event is completed and there are no more {{variable.Object_Event}} s with {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} = Active” in the {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} series, a new Event will be generated.  Example: {{variable.Field_RecEvents_RecurrenceMeth}} : "Keep One Open" {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} : "3" {{variable.Field_RecEvent_EZPreset}} = "Daily" {{variable.Field_RecEvent_FirstETStartDat}} = "Today"  Three Events will be created. Event 1’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartDate}} will be today.  Event 2’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartDate}} will be tomorrow.  Event 3’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartDate}} will be two days from today.  The night that Event 3’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} is “Completed,” a new Event (Event 4) will be created. Event 4’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartDate}} will be three days from today. {{variable.Picklist_RecET_RecMeth_AutoRen}} : After all initial {{variable.Object_Event}} s are completed and there are no more {{variable.Object_Event}} s with {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} = Active,” the {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} will generate the full {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} again. For example, 3 original {{variable.Object_Event}} s, now 3 new future {{variable.Object_Event}} s. {{variable.Field_RecEvent_DescripInternal}} : Use this field to set an internal-facing description about what the {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} is about. {{variable.Field_RecEvent_EventName}} : Use this field to identify the name of the {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} . This field offers an easy way to tell your master {{variable.Object_Event}} from the {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} s. {{variable.Field_RecEvent_CloneRelChildRe}} (optional) : This field allows {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} s to clone {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s, {{variable.Object_Session}} s, {{variable.Object_EventFAQ}} s, etc. to all child {{variable.Object_Event}} s. Basic Scheduling {{variable.Field_RecEvent_EZPreset}} : This field determines when the related {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} s should be created. For example, if you want an {{variable.Object_Event}} to reoccur every day, you would select "Daily". If the frequency of your {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} is more complex, then leave the {{variable.Field_RecEvent_EZPreset}} field blank and go to the Advanced Scheduling section. {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} : This field will set the number of {{variable.Object_Event}} s to occur. For example, If you set the {{variable.Field_RecEvent_EZPreset}} to "daily" and {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} to "5", the {{variable.Object_Event}} will occur daily for the next 5 days. (The default is set to "12" if custom settings are created. If the {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} field is blank, or custom settings are not created, the logic defaults to {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} = “3.”)   {{variable.Field_RecEvent_FirstETStartDat}} : This date determines when the first {{variable.Object_Event}} should start. {{variable.Field_RecEvent_FirstETStartTim}} : The time on the First Event Start Date that the first Event starts. {{variable.Field_RecEvent_FirstETEndDate}} : This date determines when the first {{variable.Object_Event}} should end. {{variable.Field_RecEvent_FirstETEndTime}} : The time on the First Event End Date that the first Event ends. Advanced Scheduling There are use cases where the {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} 's frequency is more complex than what is provided in the {{variable.Field_RecEvent_EZPreset}} field. For those use cases, leave the {{variable.Field_RecEvent_EZPreset}} field blank and use the Advanced Scheduling fields. {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Repeats}} {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Frequency}} {{variable.Field_RecEvent_OnThe}} {{variable.Field_RecEvent_DayOfWeek}} {{variable.Field_RecEvent_DayOfMonth}} {{variable.Field_RecEvent_MonthOfYear}} Example If your {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} needs to create an {{variable.Object_Event}} once every three weeks, it would be set up like this: {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Repeats}} = {{variable.Picklist_RecET_Repeats_Weekly}} {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Frequency}} = "3" (Each Event’s End Date will be three weeks apart.) If you did not set {{variable.Field_RecEvent_ScheduleStatus}} to “Generate”, you must click Generate to create the {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} s. Avoid Duplicate Events To prevent custom Recurring Events that were cloned from an Event in the Event Wizard from generating duplicate Events, please complete the following fields under the {{variable.Field_ETWizard_Recurring}} field. {{variable.Field_ETWizard_FirstETStartDat}} {{variable.Field_ETWizard_FirstETStartTim}} {{variable.Field_ETWizard_FirstETEndDate}} {{variable.Field_ETWizard_FirstETEndTime}} View the Recurring Event Click any of the child {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}} links on the {{variable.Object_Event}} where the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_RecurringEvent}} field is populated. To see all {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} s when viewing a {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} on a desktop, click the + icon .   To see all the Recurring Events when viewing a Recurring Event on a mobile device or tablet, tap the + icon .   Default Number of Recurring Events Created If you consistently use the same number of {{variable.Object_Event}} s, this section is for you! The {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} field will default to “12” if custom settings are created. If the {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} field is blank or custom settings are not created, the logic defaults to {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} = “3.” If you frequently schedule 4 {{variable.Object_Event}} s per month, and want to skip filling out the {{variable.Field_RecEvent_Count}} field, follow the directions below. Click Setup .  In the Quick Find box, search for and click "Custom Settings." Click Manage next to Blackthorn | Event Settings. Update the {{variable.CS_RecurringEventCount}} field to the desired default number. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Delete a {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} Record What if I need to delete 50 {{variable.Object_Event}} s, and don't want to manually delete them? Glad you asked! Navigate to your {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} 's record. In the top right-hand corner, there are options for: Cancel Delete   Clicking the {{variable.Button_RecEvent_Cancel}} button will prompt the selection of one of the three options below: {{variable.Button_RecEvent_Cancel}} will keep all the {{variable.Object_Event}} s and update the {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} 's {{variable.Field_RecEvent_ScheduleStatus}} to {{variable.Picklist_RecET_SchedStat_Cance}} . {{variable.Button_RecEvent_CancelUnpublis}} will unpublish all {{variable.Object_Event}} s, and update the {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} 's {{variable.Field_RecEvent_ScheduleStatus}} to {{variable.Picklist_RecET_SchedStat_Cance}} . {{variable.Button_RecEvent_CancelDelete}} will delete all {{variable.Object_Event}} s, and update the {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} 's {{variable.Field_RecEvent_ScheduleStatus}} to {{variable.Picklist_RecET_SchedStat_Cance}} .   {{variable.Button_RecEvent_Delete}} will permanently delete all the {{variable.Object_Event}} s, as if they were never even there.
